senses.sense_definition: Innoverend of baanbrekend; betrekking hebbend op het doorbreken van bestaande beperkingen of normen.

examples.text: De wetenschapper deed <w>grensverleggend</w> onderzoek naar nieuwe vormen van duurzame energie.

target_lang_translations.en: The scientist conducted <w>groundbreaking</w> research into new forms of sustainable energy.

examples.text: Dit bedrijf staat bekend om zijn <w>grensverleggende</w> technologie in de medische sector.

target_lang_translations.en: This company is known for its <w>pioneering</w> technology in the medical sector.

target_lang_definitions.en: Innovative or groundbreaking; relating to the act of pushing past existing limitations, boundaries, or norms.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: referring to work or ideas that are innovative and change the status quo
referring to being the first to develop or use new methods or technology
referring to challenging or extending existing limits or conventions
